title: RS-485 and Modbus RTU: long-distance industrial links

spans.text: RS-485 is a differential physical signaling layer for long, electrically noisy links. Modbus RTU is a message protocol over that link, with device address, function code, data, and CRC check. It is common in meters, building automation, and industrial sensors.

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: Connect the MCU UART to an RS-485 transceiver, never directly to A/B. The bus needs suitable 120 Ω termination at its ends, a reference ground, and direction control for two-wire half-duplex.
